versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Anubis Pro, the complete career application suite
- Generates 7 documents: tailored ATS-optimized resume, 3 cover letter tones (professional, conversational, executive), 10 interview Q&As, 3 follow-up email templates, and an application log/tracker
- Requires license key, job description, and resume path to operate
- Includes step-by-step setup instructions and output directory customization
